scenes.title: Protandry in Sunflower Disk Florets
scenes.narration: In sunflower disk florets, the anther matures before the stigma, a process called protandry.

segments.narration: In sunflower disk florets, the anther matures before the stigma, a process called protandry.
segments.visual: A stable two-stage scientific macro sequence showing the earlier pollen-bearing anther phase and the later receptive stigma phase in individual sunflower disk florets.
segments.image_prompt: Scientific macro photography of individual sunflower disk florets at clearly resolved developmental stages, botanically credible structures, sharp natural detail, no whole-head-only view, no insect, no text, no labels, no arrows.
